name: Mr.Tanaka
source:
He's a pug kept in the office.
He speaks Japanese using Wowlingual, a dog language translator created by Knight.

He has the personality of a kind, old man,
and is loved by everyone (except Yukihara).
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/tanaka]Official site[/url]]
